purpose: Add standards-based integrated loudness evidence for exact verified local integer-PCM WAV material and expose it through the existing read-only Engineering Snapshot without turning measurement into taste, mastering approval, a target, or a completed A/B decision loop.

lineage.outcome: The artist can inspect trustworthy integrated loudness evidence for the exact current local PCM Version inside the normal Song Engineering Snapshot, giving the merged Version A/B surface a standards-based measurement primitive for later loudness-aware convergence while preserving artist judgment.

why_now: AUDIO-01 remains dependency-ready and is a prerequisite of SONG-02, SONG-03 and the signature SONG-04 Try-Hear-Compare-Decide loop. The exact local Version A/B surface is merged and truthfully states RMS is not LUFS and applies no normalization. Existing Engineering Snapshot still lacks standards-based integrated loudness. A prior exact loudness implementation head proved this bounded product delta cross-platform. Main then advanced with disjoint work, most recently a verified local collaboration-handoff module with no audio or governance overlap, so the unchanged loudness delta is reconstructed atomically onto current main rather than merging stale construction truth.
instead_of_what: Do not duplicate the merged Version A/B surface, do not activate dependency-blocked SONG-04, do not build another audition/version system, and do not add DAW-specific compare behavior.

implementation_contract.input_truth: Only exact verified local integer-PCM WAV bytes already accepted by Engineering Snapshot are measured; Song, Version, Asset fingerprint and source-size binding remain mandatory and are reverified before and after analysis.
implementation_contract.measurement_truth: Integrated programme loudness is computed using a mature ITU-R BS.1770 implementation. Unsupported, too-short, silent, unavailable or inconsistent material produces an explicit non-measured state rather than invented LUFS.
implementation_contract.consumer_truth: The normal Song Engineering Snapshot distinguishes LUFS from RMS and sample peak, names the standards basis, and does not claim certification, mastering quality, a preferred target, or artistic superiority.
implementation_contract.persistence: The snapshot remains ephemeral read-only evidence. Rendering it creates no Version, approval, preference, Learning outcome or Artist World doctrine.
implementation_contract.mutation: No DAW, provider, audio file, Song Version, approval pointer, compare decision or source bytes are changed by this increment.

completion_proof: supported exact PCM WAV produces integrated loudness evidence through the normal Song consumer path
measurement is bound to the exact Song, Version, Asset fingerprint, source size and analyzer version
short or silent material reports a truthful non-measured loudness state rather than a fabricated number
corrupted or changed material still fails closed before stale loudness can surface
consumer copy separates integrated loudness from RMS/sample peak and rejects certification/taste/target claims
existing Engineering Snapshot metrics remain regression-compatible
merged Version A/B behavior remains regression-compatible and continues to make no automatic artistic decision
dependency and license footprint is explicit and cross-platform installable
full regression and staged consumer smoke pass at the reconstructed exact head

evidence_snapshot.note: This proves the loudness product delta on its earlier baseline only. The current reconstructed head requires independent exact-head proof.

non_scope: rewriting or replacing the merged A/B compare surface
shared_integration_points: Existing Engineering Snapshot composition only; merged Version A/B, collaboration handoff, and HeadquartersMemory composition are preserved untouched
next_selection_rule: After exact-head proof and integration, close this bounded receipt, refresh all live product truth, and globally reselect. A later loudness-aware Compare integration may consume this primitive only if still unowned and dependency-valid.
